name: Explicit Intersection Alpha Compositing
definition: Alpha compositing of 2D Gaussians using explicit intersection pairs (gaussian_id, pixel_id, image_id), allowing arbitrary intersection patterns and relying on automatic differentiation for the backward pass.
summary: Explicit Intersection Alpha Compositing converts Gaussian-pixel intersections into final RGB and alpha images by aggregating overlapping contributions via front-to-back compositing, distinguished by handling arbitrary intersection patterns through a flat list of pairs rather than fixed accumulation orders.
